verdict.rationale: Superpowers lets users author their own skills (writing-skills) that auto-trigger when the agent sees a matching situation, such as "Fix this bug" invoking systematic-debugging. It also ships built-in triggers: a session-start hook and an architectural review after three failed fix attempts. These triggers fire on conversational context or a few hard-coded lifecycle points, not on user-defined arbitrary events. missing for 10: user-configurable event/condition→action rules beyond prose skills, triggers on external events (files, CI, schedules, webhooks), deterministic rule execution rather than LLM-judged matching, independent corroboration of trigger reliability.
